title: CABCDE danger check for non-medics
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for a simple order for noticing life threats without pretending to diagnose.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: blocked airway, severe bleeding, weak breathing, confusion, pale cold skin, or worsening pain.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: blocked airway, severe bleeding, weak breathing, confusion, pale cold skin, or worsening pain
